name: tiling
description: Partition loop nests into smaller rectangular blocks (tiles) such that intermediate results fit in L1/L2 cache, improving data locality and reducing memory pressure. Essential for HPC kernels like matrix multiplication and convolution.

parameters.name: tile_sizes
parameters.description: List of tile sizes for each loop dimension. Non-zero values enable tiling for that dimension; zero means no tiling. For matmul (M,N,K), typical values are [32, 64, 32]. For convolution (N,F,OH,OW), try [16, 64, 2, 2]. For generic 5D tensors, try [4, 4, 8, 4, 16].
